mapper.update: UPDATE appointment_reservation_request SET status='RESERVED', reserved_at=#{request.reservedAt}, reservation_expires_at=#{request.reservationExpiresAt}, event_json=#{request.eventJson}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{request.id} AND status='CREATED'

UPDATE appointment_reservation_request SET status=#{request.status}, publish_attempts=#{request.publishAttempts}, last_error_code=#{request.lastErrorCode}, next_recovery_at=#{request.nextRecoveryAt}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{request.id} AND status IN ('RESERVED','PUBLISH_UNKNOWN')

UPDATE appointment_reservation_request SET recovery_owner = #{owner}, recovery_lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('CREATED','RESERVED','PUBLISH_UNKNOWN','COMPENSATION_PENDING') AND next_recovery_at <= #{now} AND (recovery_lease_until IS NULL OR recovery_lease_until <= #{now})
